assumptions: OpenCode 2.x as installed (2.1.4 CLI; 2.1.2 documentation consulted); plugin, MCP, skill and permission behaviour is unverified until REQ-002; Codex/Claude native plugins, the bundled runtime and the SPEC-042 lifecycle engine are reused; owner decisions D1 to D11 recorded (codemode false, legacy protocol, global plugin, portable server only through the legacy profile, version 0.1.0-alpha.7, amended 2026-11-03 because 0.1.0-alpha.6 was published without OpenCode). Plan (2026-11-03): OpenCode facts in research.md R1-R7 are documented (OpenCode 2.1.2 docs), not observed; T002 observes them and contradictions return to the owner. Owner decisions D12 (OD-9: shared plugin directory; SC-010 measured on host-read files) and D13 (OD-10: legacy server name agent-braid with a collision warning) recorded 2026-11-03.
compatibility: Additive: agent-braid-plugin/v0.2, agent-braid-tooling/v0.2, Codex and Claude Code packages, ADR 0030 naming and SPEC-042 receipts unchanged; install.sh gains an opencode host; the legacy tooling install route is frozen apart from the new opencode profile.
domain: Agent Braid native host integration for OpenCode: plugin package, MCP registration, skills and commands, setup and reconnection, lifecycle, shell installer, legacy profile, telemetry and System One invariants, distribution, documentation.
execution_contract: executionAuthorization stays false for every tool, skill and command; OpenCode permissions and approvals are host decisions, not Agent Braid grants; no plugin hook; grants remain operator-issued outside the host; no automatic MCP reload.
hypotheses: None; engineering specification with no scientific claim.
observation_contract: Host matrix and native observation record OpenCode version, platform, command, observed behaviour and limits in a disposable profile; unobserved items stay unobserved; OpenCode session identifiers are never stored.

obtained_evidence.limits: Unit tests of the entry module with a synthetic host context. The MCP core results are the unchanged SPEC-046 tests (test_plugin_mcp); no stdio fixture drives the entry's registered command, and the real host starting the server is T010 (unobserved).
obtained_evidence.outcome: OpenCode entry module (tests/test_opencode_entry.py, 22 tests): source parse finds none of the forbidden APIs and each forbidden API inserted into a copy is detected; registered values follow the contract; one server, seven skills and two commands; repeated transforms are idempotent; a foreign agent-braid server and existing skills are never replaced, updated or removed; a broken host context never throws. Merged in PR #1022 (f7bdf78f).

Ship an OpenCode plugin package that registers the existing `agent-braid-plugin/v0.2` MCP server (`plugin serve`) through the bundled runtime launcher as a user-global `local` server with `codemode: false` and the default `legacy` protocol (D7 to D9), with no change to the server contract.
